result.summary: REQ-201 (OBS-06 alerting hooks) fully implemented. Two per-tenant migrations, Letflow.Obs.Alerts context module with ARMED/FIRED edge-triggered state machine, retry/backoff HTTP delivery, no-DLQ terminal action, Scheduler.Poller integration (lag tracking), Dlq.count_entries/1 aggregate, 17 tests covering all 14 ACs, tenant_fixture oracle updated (26->28 tables).

git_commits.message: feat(REQ-201): alerting hooks -- edge-triggered threshold detection with retry/backoff delivery (OBS-06)

result.mix_test_last_line: Result: 57 passed (targeted run covering alerts_test, tenant_fixture_test, poller_test, requirement_status_invariants_test)

oq_resolutions.OQ-1: Letflow.Secrets.resolve/2 requires [tenant_id: uuid] in opts; namespace 'alert_hook' is embedded in the reference string sec://tenant/<slug>/alert_hook/<name> and is valid per ~r/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/. To call resolve for platform-level alert hook secrets, the tenant_id is derived from the reference's own slug via Identity.get_tenant_by_slug/1. On any resolution failure, the Authorization header is omitted and a warning is logged (no crash, no credential stored).
oq_resolutions.OQ-2: Letflow.Dlq.count_entries/1 did not exist. Added as a public function in lib/letflow/dlq.ex following the existing opts :: [prefix: String.t()] pattern: Repo.aggregate(Entry, :count, prefix: prefix). Read-only aggregate, no new requirement needed.
oq_resolutions.OQ-3: Recently-paused subscriptions query uses paused_at >= last_tick_started_at. When last_tick_started_at is nil (first tick), the paused-subscription check is skipped entirely. webhook_subscriptions.paused_at confirmed available (Subscription schema has :paused_at field).
oq_resolutions.OQ-4: Confirmed: Letflow.Obs.Alerts has no start_link/1, no child_spec/1, no process. application.ex is unchanged. Detection runs on Letflow.Scheduler.Poller's existing tick via maybe_run_alert_detection/3 (private, called from handle_info(:tick)).
